stories.title: Do school phone bans help students learn? So far, gains are ‘modest.’
stories.summary: Ask any teacher — or teenager — and they’ll tell you that some phone bans are largely cosmetic.

stories.title: Could checked-swing reviews curb strikeouts? Hitters benefited in minor league testing.
stories.summary: The introduction of robot umpire appeals for checked-swing calls in the Triple-A Pacific Coast League this year led to lower swing-and-miss rates on breaking and offspeed pitches.

stories.title: Glasses, shirt buttons will be examined to stop cheating in South Korea’s high-stakes college entrance exams
stories.summary: The sweeping measures are in response to concerns that artificial intelligence and smart devices are making fraud harder to detect.

stories.title: Tiger Woods announces his return to competition
stories.summary: The legendary golfer will play at the Hero World Challenge in early December following a long hiatus following injuries and his arrest on DUI charges.

stories.title: FAA temporarily stops router installations connected to air travel stoppage
stories.summary: The agency has been struggling to modernize the air traffic control system for decades — going back well before the first Trump administration.

stories.title: New lawmakers play a Capitol Hill game, with prime office space as the prize
stories.summary: For incoming freshmen, the ritual of the House office lottery makes their wins feel real.

stories.title: Van Hollen’s bid to replace Schumer as leader is putting pressure on Democrats to take sides
stories.summary: It’s the first contested election for Senate Democratic leader in decades.

stories.title: Communications system at top-secret National Security Agency goes down
stories.summary: A key internal message system used by NSA employees to exchange classified messages was out of commission, according to three current and former U.S. officials.

stories.title: Alaska Gov.-elect Kreiss-Tomkins announces transition team as he prepares to take office
stories.summary: The incoming Democratic governor named a bipartisan team to guide the transition process.

stories.title: ICE is detaining green-card holders over decades-old, minor violations
stories.summary: Authorities are detaining people over charges that did not come up when applying for or renewing green cards and that in the past would have resulted in a citation — not an effort to remove legal status.

stories.title: Senate Democrats demand clear-cut answers on what caused grounding of planes
stories.summary: The Trump administration on Tuesday sent a letter to key lawmakers updating its request for $50.1 billion to modernize the system and make other improvements at airports.

stories.title: Nvidia chairman says board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: The announcement followed Huang’s statement earlier in the day that he would come back to lead the company if the board invited him.
